# The configuration used by collaborator llvm-beanz in
# https://github.com/microsoft/DirectXShaderCompiler/issues/4648#issuecomment-1814799986
# (read back from https://godbolt.org/api/shortlinkinfo/M4TfanMfr on 2026-08-10):
#
#   compiler: dxc_trunk   options: -T vs_6_6 -enable-16bit-types
#   source:   unsigned int16_t g;\n\nvoid main() {\n}
#
# repro.hlsl is that source byte-for-byte. The issue body itself names no profile,
# no entry point and no command line at all -- only the single declaration.
#
# cmd.txt lowers vs_6_6 to vs_6_2 for release-history reach: 16-bit types are gated on
# shader model >= 6.2, and vs_6_6 exists only from v1.6.2106 onwards, which would make
# every earlier release an invalid probe for a reason unrelated to the defect.
# variant-repro-at-vs66-*.txt is the equivalence control showing the two profiles fail
# identically on ground truth.
-T vs_6_6 -enable-16bit-types repro.hlsl
